scope.note: No numbered R or C identifier falls in this scope. Tables 10.5, 10.6 and 10.7 are base units in their own right and are accounted as such. Counts are post-correction; the original proposal declared 21 requirements and 77 facets before C10LR-001 and C10LR-002 removed two requirements and their nine facets.

authoring.author_context: fresh subagent context in an isolated worktree based on 109161c
authoring.note: The original proposal commit is immutable; the correction is a separate commit on top of it. The integrator verified that all eight catalogue and view files on main are byte-identical to the corrected branch before recording any review.

independent_review.closeout_reverification: Source re-read from the pinned PDF with all 24 unit hashes unchanged; rendered views confirmed to match the corrected JSON; no dangling or reused requirement identifiers left by the two deletions; gates re-run by the reviewer.

findings.defect: The sentence 'Once the interpretation of a logical intrinsic operation is established, the processor may evaluate any other expression that is logically equivalent, provided that the integrity of parentheses in any expression is not violated' was catalogued as an effect requirement. It is processor latitude, not an obligation, and this project's standing precedent is that latitude is dispositioned permission and never given a plan asserting the processor exercised it.
findings.closure: Requirement S10.1.5.4.2-001 removed. All 10.1.5.4.2 p1 fine units are now dispositioned permission and the p2 units definition. The all-primaries equivalence condition and the parenthesis-integrity limit survive as boundaries of the permission in the accounting rationales. Nothing in the packet now asserts that a rewrite was, or was not, performed - a plan attempting to detect the rewrite would itself be a defect.

findings.defect: The relational analogue of C10LR-001 ('any other expression that is relationally equivalent') was likewise catalogued as an effect requirement.
findings.closure: Requirement S10.1.5.5.2-001 removed and the units reclassified as permission. The parenthesis-integrity limit and the NaN limit from the subclause note survive as permission boundaries; the reviewer confirmed at closeout that deleting the requirement did not delete the substantive content of the sentence.

findings.defect: Repeated relational oracle guidance told a future author to use 'exact small integer, logical, enumeration, enum, and same-kind character literals with independent oracles'. Two operands of type logical cannot be compared with a relational intrinsic operator - 10.1.5.5.1 NOTE 1 says so and Table 10.2 does not admit them - so a logical-operand relational positive control would not even be a conforming program.
findings.closure: 14 occurrences corrected: 13 rephrased in 10.1.5.5.1 and one removed with the deleted 10.1.5.5.2 requirement. The reviewer independently confirmed the count and that no logical-operand relational oracle remains anywhere in the packet.

evaluation_latitude.detail: Logically equivalent alternative evaluation is a processor permission; the all-primaries condition and the parenthesis-integrity limit are its boundaries.
Relationally equivalent alternative evaluation is a processor permission; the parenthesis-integrity limit and the NaN limit are its boundaries.

table_assessment.Table 10.5: pass; the five operator rows for .NOT., .AND., .OR., .EQV. and .NEQV. are accounted row by row and map to S10.1.5.4.1-002 through -006. The two-line .EQV. and .NEQV. interpretations are preserved and no short-circuit inference is present.
table_assessment.Table 10.6: pass; the four truth-assignment rows cover all five operator requirements. .NOT. depends only on x2, so the apparently duplicated x1 cases are genuine table rows rather than missing operator rows.
table_assessment.Table 10.7: pass; twelve rows give the dotted and symbolic forms for the six relational operators, accounted row by row with symbolic/dotted equivalence tied to p2. The '< =' and '> =' strings produced by the pinned text extraction are extraction artefacts for '<=' and '>=' - visual layout extraction of the original page confirms this. They are NOT alternative spellings, and the packet correctly does not mint separate spaced-token operator requirements; token ownership stays with R1014 in 10.1.2.7.

substantive_verdicts.character_collation_attribution: pass. 10.1.5.5.1 p8 uses 'collating sequence' and cites term 3.27, which points to 7.4.4.4, whose p1-p5 define the processor, default, ASCII and ISO 10646 collation constraints and identify LGT/LGE/LLE/LLT as separate ASCII-collation intrinsic comparisons. 7.4.4.4 is correctly treated as the owner of native character relational collation, 3.27 as terminology, and 16.9.124-16.9.127 as a dependency boundary rather than a substitute owner. Blank padding of the shorter operand is stated explicitly in S10.1.5.5.1-010, with nondefault padding limited by NOTE 2.
substantive_verdicts.nan_sensitive_relations: pass. The 10.1.5.5.2 note observes that the possibility of a NaN makes .NOT.(x .LT. y) and x .GE. y non-equivalent. The packet leaves NaN-sensitive rewrites as pending boundaries and asserts no portable NaN result.
substantive_verdicts.mixed_numeric_conversion: pass. 10.1.5.5.1 p6 owns the rule that relational operands are converted to the type and kind of x1+x2; determining the type and kind of x1+x2 is correctly delegated to 10.1.9.3 p4 rather than duplicated.
substantive_verdicts.short_circuit_and_grouping: pass. The logical catalogues explicitly forbid side-effect, call-count, execution-path and skipped-operand oracles for .AND. and .OR., and record that the grouping of an associative intrinsic operation is not value-observable while attributing non-associative defined extensions to 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.

explicit_limitations: This batch registers source accounting only. It is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it creates no test case.
All 68 facets in scope remain pending. No logical or relational value oracle is approved by this batch.
10.1.5.4.2 and 10.1.5.5.2 yield zero facets each. That records that their normative content is processor latitude, not that character or logical evaluation is source-complete.
No portable NaN-related relational result is claimed, and no character collating sequence beyond what 7.4.4.4 constrains is assumed.
No compiler was invoked during authoring or review. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations.

preservation.index_json_conflict_resolution: The parallel batch101 and batch102 packets both append to doc/catalogues/index.json. The conflict was resolved by keeping both appends in registration order; no entry was dropped or reordered.
